references.text: Balaam meets the angel of the Lord with a drawn sword, a similar theophany where a heavenly figure stands with a sword in hand
Balaam sees the angel standing with a drawn sword, parallel to Joshua's vision of the man with the drawn sword
The cherubim with flaming swords guarding the way to the tree of life show heavenly figures with swords
Abraham lifts his eyes and sees three men standing before him, similar wording about lifting one's eyes to see a heavenly figure
Jacob wrestles with a man who turns out to be a heavenly figure, parallel to Joshua's encounter with the heavenly commander
Moses at the burning bush is told to take off his sandals because the place is holy, the same command given to Joshua in the next verse
David sees the angel of the Lord standing between earth and heaven with a drawn sword over Jerusalem
Zechariah's vision of a man among the myrtle trees, a heavenly figure revealing himself to the prophet
John sees the Son of Man with a sharp double-edged sword coming out of his mouth, a heavenly figure with a sword
Christ as a heavenly warrior with a sword, parallel to the commander of the Lord's army whom Joshua meets
Reference to the fall of Jericho by faith, the context for Joshua's encounter with the heavenly commander
